response.original_title: America’s Extreme Cults: The End of the World That Never Happened
response.overview: ‘America’s Extreme Cults: The End of the World That Never Happened’ explores the followers of religious broadcaster Harold Camping, who predicted that Judgment Day would occur on May 21, 2011. Through personal accounts and psychological insights, the documentary examines how ordinary people become convinced of apocalyptic prophecies and the emotional consequences they face when the predicted end of the world never arrives.
response.tagline: The end of the world. Or is it?
response.title: America’s Extreme Cults: The End of the World That Never Happened
